newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet fuel differentials weaken slightly.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet fuel differentials weaken slightly.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel differentials showed some modest weakness Tuesday, though activity remained fairly subdued.
On the NYMEX, August heating oil gained 0.32 cents to settle at 53.10 cents a gallon.
Prompt U.S. Gulf 54-grade jet fuel traded at 0.10 cent over the August futures early in the day but fell to flat with the screen later, according to traders.
Narket players said there appeared to be little serious interest in barrels for delivery at the end of the month.
New York Harbor prompt 55-grade barrels were talked near 2.00 cents over the August futures, down about 0.30 cent from Monday's levels.
